facts.fact: 傍晚 Caren 卧床听有声书，前门打开后 Kugel 叫、Miguel 喊她、Rachel 逗狗
facts.anchor: Late in the evening, I am sitting in bed listening to an audiobook, because reading still gives me a headache

facts.fact: 家里的声响比任何药都让她安定
facts.anchor: Those sounds of a family home calm me better than any medication ever could.

facts.fact: 她在楼梯口抱住刚回家的 Rachel，抱得近乎绝望
facts.anchor: I hug her with desperate intensity as if she might vanish if I don’t hold her tight enough.

facts.fact: Rachel 在户外待了十天，晒黑、头发被太阳晒出金色
facts.anchor: she’s tan and scruffy looking—as she should be after spending ten days in the outdoors

facts.fact: Rachel 早有一份工作：她从小参加的网球营的初级辅导员
facts.anchor: She’s going to be a junior counselor at a tennis camp she’s attended since she was little.

facts.fact: 医院发的说明写着，情绪大起大落可能是脑震荡的后遗症之一
facts.anchor: The handout from the hospital says that big emotional swings can be one of the effects of a concussion

facts.fact: Kenya 承认在 Facebook 上看到 Holly 的消息却忘了回
facts.anchor: I saw them and put reaching out to her on my list of things to get to, but it slipped my mind.

facts.fact: Caren 不相信 Kenya 的说辞
facts.anchor: That woman has never dropped a ball in her life.
